Definition: from G5046; (the state) completeness (mentally or morally):--perfection(-ness).
BiblicalUsage: The word is perfection, completeness, the bond that holds all together. Paul says, above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness; and the writer says, leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe love is the bond of perfectness, and going on to perfection is going on in love.
